description: This file provides authentication utility functions for user sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth sign-in, sign-out, password update, error handling, and retrieving current user/session in a React project utilizing Supabase.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional metadata, utilizing a redirect URL after sign-up.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a specified redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in a user using a magic link via email.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Initiates OAuth sign-in with a specified provider.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles various authentication errors by providing user feedback and redirecting suitably.
